import sys

MOD = 998244353

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    result = 1
    factor = base
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = result * factor % MOD
        factor = factor * factor % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])

    area = N * M
    length = R - L + 1
    value = mod_pow(length, area)

    if area % 2 == 1:
        print(value)
    elif length % 2 == 0:
        print(value * ((MOD + 1) // 2) % MOD)
    else:
        print((value + 1) * ((MOD + 1) // 2) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
